fields.title: 📖 No Īmān without complete submission
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“No, by your Lord, they do not believe until they make you judge in what is disputed between them, then find in themselves no distress over your judgment, and submit completely.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The core of Muḥākamah is not only the outward judgment, but Taslīm: the heart submits to the judgment of the Messenger ﷺ.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:65.
